cited.quote: The Government have accorded administrative sanction for acquisition of 535.10 acres of patta land
administrative sanction has been accorded for acquiring 96.79 acres of additional land for expansion of Thoothukudi Airport

rationale: C1 and C2 show administrative sanction for land acquisition for Salem and Thoothukudi airport expansion, with Salem acquisition still under process and Thoothukudi additional land acquisition just initiated. Land steps are official but expansion and modernisation are not shown operational.

cited.quote: striving hard to operationalise the Cyber Crime Police Stations (CCPS) in each district/city
the State Cyber Crime Investigation Centre at the Cyber Crime Wing Headquarters, Chennai shall be a Police Station

rationale: C1 says cyber crime police stations were created and staffed but the wing is still trying to operationalise them in each district through notification. C2 notifies only the single state-level centre as a police station, not all districts. Not yet operational in all districts.

The promise does not name what provision is to be repealed, and no extract concerns repeal of any identifiable provision (extracts cover GST, labour rules, vehicle disposal). No extract is about the commitment.

cited.quote: Orders issued for constructing a Manimandapam with full size statue for Pollan, the commander of Dheeran Chinnamalai’s Army

rationale: C1 reports orders issued for a Manimandapam with full size statue for Pollan at Modakurichi, Erode District, at Rupees One Crore and Eighty Two Lakh. This is an official step but the statue is not reported as erected, and no GO date is given.

cited.quote: STUs are issuing zero value tickets to women passengers for survey purposes from 12.07.2021
transgender persons to travel free on town buses (white boards)

rationale: C1 and C2 state orders allow all women to travel free in ordinary town buses across all State Transport Undertakings, with ridership counts from 12.07.2021. The GO date is not given, so the earliest written operational date in C1 is used.

No extract concerns reclamation or restoration of inscriptions held at the Archaeological Survey office in Mysore. C1 and C2 are general archaeology notes; C4 and C5 concern mine reclamation, which is unrelated.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu has attained 100% sanitation coverage under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen)

rationale: C3 reports existing rural sanitation coverage including community toilets, and C5 covers housing for kutcha house families, but neither shows a step to construct and maintain common toilets in areas with many kutcha houses. Related activity only.

cited.quote: The proposed Check Dam site lies in Javvathupatti village of Oddanchatram Taluk in Dindigul District

rationale: C2 is a sanction GO for check dams including one in Oddanchatram Taluk in the Amaravathi sub-basin. This is an official step for the region, but construction is not shown and nothing covers Thoppampatti or the Varada and Shanmuga rivers.

cited.quote: being paid a monthly pension of ₹ 1000/- by the Government benefitting 121 retired

rationale: C1 shows temple employee pensions still at Rs 1000 for archakars and similar staff (Rs 3,000 for village poosaris), with no increase to Rs 5000. The Pongal prize in C4 is for government pensioners, not retired temple employees.

cited.quote: Surveys will be taken to construct new fishing harbours at a total cost of Rs.6.25 crore

rationale: C3 is a budget speech announcing surveys for new harbours and allocations; C2 only speaks of strengthening infrastructure. No GO, tender or other official step for harbours and cold storage across all coastal areas is shown.

cited.quote: Agricultural Zonal Committees will be formed consisting of officials from Departments of Agriculture

rationale: C2 only says the zonal committees and the high level committee will be formed or constituted, a statement of intent. C1 repeats the plan in a budget speech. No GO or constitution of the committees is shown.

cited.quote: So far, 470607 UDID cards have been generated out of 873561 Registration.

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 show disability identity cards and the central UDID card project, long existing, but no new smart card for persons with disabilities. C4 concerns smart ration family cards, a different subject.

cited.quote: An embryo transfer programme for the production of 105 Kangayam and 55 Bargur cattle is being implemented
To conserve and propagate these native breeds, a Dog Breeding Unit is functioning at Saidapet, Chennai

rationale: C1 mentions a Kangayam embryo transfer programme but gives no start date or order, and C2 shows a dog breeding unit running since 1980. These are continuing activities with no dated new measure, so no dedicated new step is shown.

providing financial relief assistance of Rs.5000/- during the non-seasonal period

rationale: C1 records that the first GO, dated 14.12.2021, sanctioned Rs 5,000 per annum relief for registered salt workers' families during the non-seasonal period; C2 sanctions funds for 8465 workers for October to December 2021. Limited to registered workers.

cited.quote: is being provided on completion of 6 months of age of a child

rationale: C1 and C3 describe the existing ICDS supplementary nutrition and sathumavu for infants, including extra quantity for severely malnourished children. No new infant welfare scheme is shown; C4 and C5 concern midwifery and maternal care.

cited.quote: Temple Ponds of HR and CE which serve recharge functionality may be taken up with NOC
Deepening and de-silting the temple tanks

rationale: C1, a GO dated 2022-03-08, allows HR and CE temple ponds with recharge function to be taken up for desilting under the rural water body scheme, with a NOC. C3 reports periodic departmental renovation of temple tanks. Coverage across the state is not shown.

cited.quote: To facilitate the easy movement of elderly, free bus pass was introduced.

rationale: C1 only says a free bus pass for the elderly was introduced, with no date, age threshold or order, so it reads as an existing concession. C2 and C3 cover free travel for women and students. No step for free travel for those above 70 is shown.
